_comment: Golden field set for one `/v1/models` (and `/v1/models/{model}`) entry.
`typed` is every key the gateway emits that an SDK ModelInfo type MUST
declare; `excluded` is every key it emits that an SDK MUST NOT declare,
each with the reason. A new wire field fails both SDK tests until it is
consciously placed in one bucket or the other — that is the point.

excluded.created: OpenAI retrieve-model compat only. Fixed sentinel epoch (SIE has no per-model creation time); OpenAI clients use it for display/sorting. Carries no SIE meaning.
excluded.id: OpenAI retrieve-model compat only. Byte-identical to `name`; typing both would imply they can differ.
excluded.object: OpenAI retrieve-model compat only. Constant "model" discriminator for the OpenAI envelope.

notes.excluded_scope: The four excluded keys are merged in by GET /v1/models/{model} for vanilla OpenAI 'retrieve model' clients; on GET /v1/models they live in the sibling `data` array instead, never on a `models` entry.
notes.optionality: Python marks every typed key optional (`total=False`). TypeScript requires `name`, `loaded`, `inputs` and `outputs` on both `ModelInfo` and `WireModelInfo`; its remaining keys are optional. `pending_generation` is gateway-only. `last_error`/`max_sequence_length`/`revision`/`capabilities` are the four the emitters can send as an explicit null, so the SDK types admit null on each. The fixture pins which keys are declarable, not which are always present.
notes.ts_renames: The TS SDK camelCases three top-level keys — max_sequence_length -> maxSequenceLength, last_error -> lastError, pending_generation -> pendingGeneration — and leaves nested objects wire-shaped. Its consumer test checks the wire-side names listed here.
notes.aliases: Short task-tier names resolving to this model. Always emitted, empty when the model has none, so callers can distinguish 'no aliases' from an older gateway. Only catalog- or operator-declared names appear; the gateway's compiled-in routing defaults are not public API and are never listed.
notes.routing: How the bare model name is served: `policy` (`remote_only`, `fallback`, `threshold`, or null for local only) and `upstream_kind` (`sie`, `openai`, or null). The single server emits it on every entry. The gateway declares it and will emit it once cluster remote worker pools exist.
